glossary.definition: (1) "Peace officer" has the same meaning as in section 109.71 of the Revised Code.
glossary.source_title: Section 109.803 - Continuing professional training for peace officers and troopers.

glossary.definition: (2) "Trooper" means an individual appointed as a state highway patrol trooper under section 5503.01 of the Revised Code.
glossary.source_title: Section 109.803 - Continuing professional training for peace officers and troopers.

glossary.definition:
(3) "Appointing authority" means any agency or entity that appoints a peace officer or trooper.
